L104: 【37†Apink】's (pictured) win for "【38†Dilemma】" had the highest score of 2022, with 9,700 points at the February 22nd broadcast.
L105: 
L106: 【39†The Show】 Chart is a 【40†music program】 【41†record chart】 on SBS M that gives an award to the best-performing 【42†single】 of the week in South Korea.^{【43†[1]】}
L107: 
L108: In 2022, 24 singles achieved number one on the chart, and 22 acts were awarded first-place trophies. "【38†Dilemma】" by 【37†Apink】 had the highest score of the year, with 9,700 points on the February 22 broadcast.
L109: ## Chart history

L114: 
L115: 【47†Miyeon】 of 【48†(G)I-dle】 (left) and 【49†Jo Yu-ri】 (right) received their first ever music show wins as soloists with "【50†Drive】" and "Love Shhh!", respectively.
L116: 
L117: 【51†Le Sserafim】 (top) and 【52†DKZ】 (bottom) won their first ever music show trophies for "【53†Fearless】" and "Uh-Heung", respectively.
